newsitem.title: FINLAND: SENTRA SELLS UNIT TO RAUTAKIRJA.
newsitem.headline: SENTRA SELLS UNIT TO RAUTAKIRJA.

text.p: Finnish retail and fast food group Sentra Oy said in a statement on Monday it will sell its Pizza Hut franchise chain to retail group Rautakirja Oy.
The price of the deal was not given.

Pizza Hut accounts for about seven percent of Sentra's annual net sales, it said, adding full-year 1996 group net sales would rise to nearly 800 million markka, of which its Carrols hamburger restaurant chain would generate 170 million.
"The revenues from the deal will be targeted at the development of Carrols," Sentra said, adding that three combined Pizza Hut and Carrols restaurants were not included in the deal.
In a separate statement, Rautakirja said its EuroStrada Oy unit will start to cooperate with Pepsico -- the developer of the Pizza Hut pizza chain -- to rapidly boost Pizza Hut operations in Finland.
"EuroStrada intends to expand the Pizza Hut chain by tens of units into a national chain," Rautakirja said.
The combined net sales of the 10 Pizza Hut restaurants now acquired by Rautakirja from Sentra are about 50 million markka, it said.
